example_sentences_in_bangla: চায়ের কাপটা কবোষ্ণ হয়ে গেছে, আর গরম নেই।
আবহাওয়া কবোষ্ণ, বাইরে ঘুরতে ভালো লাগবে।
example_sentences_in_english: The cup of tea has become lukewarm, it's no longer hot.
The weather is lukewarm, it would be nice to go out.
note: This idiom is often used in everyday contexts to describe moderate warmth, rooted in classical Bengali vocabulary.
